about_the_game:
Genre: Turn-Based Strategy / Tactical Game with Local and Online PvP

Description:
Clash of the Kingdoms is a strategic game where two players compete for dominance on the battlefield, relying on tactical thinking, unique squads, and their own strategy. The events take place in a medieval fantasy world, where each battle is a true test of wit and composure.

Each player commands an army of 10 unique warriors. The goal — either destroy the enemy’s forces or capture their fortress.

Game Modes:

  • Battle against AI — face a challenging opponent whose logic is handcrafted for the most realistic tactical decisions.

  • Local mode on one device — compete with a friend on the same computer by taking turns.

  • Online battles — play with friends or random opponents via Steam integration.

Key Features:

  • Turn-based battles on a 7×7 tile grid.

  • Historical factions — each based on real cultures and military traditions of the Middle Ages. In the collection, players can explore detailed descriptions of each faction, their strengths and weaknesses, unique units, and historical background.

  • Various tactical playstyles: from rapid maneuvers to positional defense.

  • Handcrafted AI that analyzes the battlefield and makes decisions like a real player.

  • Atmospheric medieval-style soundtrack.

  • Upcoming update at release: customization of the battlefield, faction appearances, and personal titles.

  • Short 5-10 minute matches — perfect for quick tactical duels.

Why You’ll Love Clash of the Kingdoms:
This is a game for those who value intellectual duels, well-thought-out tactics, and the unpredictability of their opponent. There’s no place for luck here — only your strategic decisions determine the outcome.
